reuse.why: Fintegra reuses bank selection, linking and import helpers, but local unlink state and token-based downloading remain duplicated.

duplication.why: The change duplicates unlink field clearing, existing transaction-download logic and the validation sequence across six handler registrations.

placement.why: Changes stay within the established account modules, but an assertion performs unlink mutations and a SimpleFIN-specific handler becomes a shared provider implementation.

scope.why: All edits address the requested linking policies, replacement support or Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Duplicated policy orchestration, mutation hidden inside an assertion and widened provider-specific interfaces make future changes unnecessarily fragile.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts: assertBankAccountIsNotLinked reproduces unlinkAccount's local reset instead of extracting that reset for both paths.

disguised_duplication.where: accounts/sync.ts: downloadTokenTransactions reshapes existing token-authenticated download logic into a purported shared helper while downloadAkahuTransactions remains independent.

abstraction_drift.where: Shared implementations gain replaceExistingLink and syncSource parameters; replacement, orgDomain presence and endpoint selection introduce branches, while the Akahu sync path bypasses downloadTokenTransactions.
